modules.title: History of Computer Networks and the Internet , types of net
modules.topics: History of Computer Networks and the Internet , types of networks, Client- server and peer-to-peer architecture. Design issues for the layers – Interface & Service – Service Primitives. Reference models – OSI – TCP/IP. Concept of Quality of Service metrics - throughput, delay, packet loss, and jitter in packet-switched networks.

modules.topics: Physical layer design issues - Media, Signal strength and interference. Data encoding, Multiplexing (TDM, FDM). Data Link layer Design Issues – Flow Control and ARQ techniques. Data link Protocols – HDLC. IEEE 802 FOR LANs IEEE 802.3, 802.5. Wireless LANs - 802.11.

modules.title: Networking devices - Bridges, Routers, Gateways, Network Lay
modules.topics: Networking devices - Bridges, Routers, Gateways, Network Layer Protocols - Virtual circuits and datagrams, Principles of routing, internet protocol Ipv4 CIDR, IPv6, Network Address Translation , Firewalls, and VPNs Routing algorithms - Link-state and distance vector routing, Routing on the internet RIP OSPF and BGP.

modules.topics: Introduction to transport layer, Multiplexing and de-multiplexing, Principles of Reliable data transfer – end-to - end flow control mechanisms, Connection oriented transport TCP, Connectionless transport UDP. Application layer protocols - HTTP and HTTPs, FTP, SMTP- S/MIME, DNS, and Peer-to-peer file sharing networks
